commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - **Phase 5 (home/app page WASM wiring) — confirmed, no code changes needed.** `worker.ts`, `webmcp.ts`, `teeline-wasm.d.ts` all diff byte-identical against `master` (zero changes since Phase 0). `index.astro` has zero `client:*` directives anywhere on the page — `BaseLayout`, `FeatureCards`, `AlgorithmCards` are all plain server-rendered Astro components with no hydration boundary at all, so the WebMCP hidden forms (plain sibling HTML, not nested in any component) trivially satisfy the "must stay in static, non-hydrated output" constraint. Full solve flow was already verified end-to-end in Phase 3. Nothing to commit for this phase.

- Next: Phase 6 (explainer islands) — `src/pages/algorithms/[id]/explainer/index.astro` dynamic route, wire all 10 `.tsx` explainer components with `client:visible`, delete the 10 `*-page.ts` mount scripts.
- **Phase 6 (explainer islands) — done, with two real Astro constraints discovered the hard way.** All 10 explainer pages ported to `src/pages/algorithms/[id]/explainer/index.astro`.

- Built `src/explainers/registry.ts` (title/description/backLabel metadata per solver, `EXPLAINER_IDS` list) plus the dynamic route. Went through **three iterations** before landing on a working pattern:
1. First attempt: `getStaticPaths()` referencing an outer frontmatter `const EXPLAINERS` object (with lazy `component: () => import(...)` loaders) → build failed with `"EXPLAINERS is not defined"`.

2. Second attempt: decoupled to a plain `EXPLAINER_IDS` array, still defined as an outer frontmatter const → same failure, `"EXPLAINER_IDS is not defined"`. This revealed the real constraint (not about dynamic imports specifically): **`getStaticPaths()` runs in an isolated scope and can only reference variables it imports or defines itself** — a documented Astro rule I'd forgotten. Fixed by moving `EXPLAINER_IDS`/metadata into `registry.ts` and *importing* it (imports are explicitly allowed).

3. Third attempt: with `getStaticPaths()` fixed, tried `const ExplainerComponent = COMPONENTS[id]` (a map of statically-imported components) then `<ExplainerComponent client:visible />` → built fine, but failed at prerender with `NoMatchingImport`. **Astro does not support dynamically rendering a UI-framework component with a `client:*` directive at all** — even via a variable indexed from a map of statically-imported components. The hydrated component must be a literal JSX tag naming an imported identifier directly. Fixed with 10 explicit `{id === 'pso' && <PsoExplainer client:visible />}`-style branches instead of one indirected tag.

- Also hit a naming collision: `lk.ts` (pure simulation logic) and `lk.tsx` (the component) both exist in `src/explainers/`; a bare `import LkExplainer from '../explainers/lk'` silently resolved to the wrong file (`lk.ts`, no default export) rather than `lk.tsx`. Original `lk-page.ts` already worked around this with an explicit `.tsx` extension — matched that.

- Verified via `astro-island` inspection in the built HTML that per-page code-splitting works correctly despite all 10 components being statically imported in the shared frontmatter: `/algorithms/pso/explainer/` ships `component-url="/assets/pso.*.js"`, `/algorithms/gsa/explainer/` ships `gsa.*.js` — not all 10 bundled into every page.

- Verified via Playwright across all 10 explainer pages: correct titles, hydrated content present (checked `astro-island` has rendered children), zero console errors. Screenshotted `/algorithms/pso/explainer/` — the live particle-swarm visualization renders and hydrates correctly.

- **Deliberately did NOT delete the 10 old `*-page.ts` mount scripts** (unlike the plan's literal Phase 6 description) — the still-live Vite pipeline's `algorithms/<id>/explainer/index.html` shells reference them directly via `<script src="/src/explainers/<id>-page.ts">`; deleting them now would be a real **build failure** for `npm run build:check` (Vite can't resolve the script src), not just a runtime degradation like the Phase 3 `main.ts` edit. Consistent with the Phase 1/3 deferral pattern: old mount scripts + HTML shells get deleted together at Phase 9/10 cutover, keeping the still-live pipeline buildable until then.
- `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), `npm run build:check` (still-live Vite pipeline, completely unmodified this phase) all pass.

- Next: Phase 7 (nav/SEO parity + RSS) — diff `@astrojs/sitemap` output against full expected coverage (now including the 10 explainer pages), add `src/pages/rss.xml.js` for the blog, spot-check OG/canonical tags per page type, replace the placeholder blog post if desired.

commit.message:
Log Phase 6 (explainer islands) completion for Astro migration

All 10 explainer pages ported. Discovered two real, previously-unknown
Astro constraints the hard way (3 build iterations): getStaticPaths()
runs in an isolated scope (imports only, no outer frontmatter consts),
and client:* hydration directives cannot target a component selected
dynamically via a variable/map — must be a literal JSX tag naming a
statically-imported identifier. Also hit an lk.ts/lk.tsx naming
collision. Deliberately kept the old *-page.ts mount scripts (deleting
now would break the still-live Vite build, not just degrade runtime) —
deferred to Phase 9/10 cutover per the established pattern.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
